in_marathi.name: Shivdayal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Auspiciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivdayal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivdayal is a name derived from two Sanskrit words: Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction, and dayal, which means compassionate or merciful. This name is often given to a child born on auspicious days or to one who is believed to be blessed by Shiva. It symbolizes the divine qualities of power, strength, and compassion.
